info.name: accounting-system
info.description: Backend API for a multi-tenant, dual-currency ERP platform for Lebanese trading companies. See docs/API-DESIGN.md for envelope, pagination, and money-field conventions.

request.description: Authenticate with email + password. On success, the test script saves accessToken and refreshToken into the environment for use by every other request.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Invalid credentials

request.description: Always returns 200 with the same generic body, whether or not the email belongs to a registered, active account — this must never be usable to enumerate registered emails. If the account exists, a 6-digit code is emailed (mailpit in dev: http://localhost:8025). Throttled to 3 requests/15 min per IP; also no-ops (same response) if a live code was issued in the last 30s.

response.name: 200 OK (generic, always)
429 Too many requests

request.description: Checks a 6-digit reset code before the client shows the new-password step, without consuming it or changing anything — Reset password (with code) still re-validates the code itself and is what actually spends it. Shares the same attempts ceiling and throttling as Reset password.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Invalid or expired code
429 Too many incorrect attempts

request.description: Resets the password using the 6-digit code emailed by Forgot password. On success, the password changes, the code is single-use (cannot be replayed), and every existing refresh token for the user is revoked (all other sessions end). code must match /^\d{6}$/. See docs/API-DESIGN.md → Password reset for the full error-code table (AUTH_INVALID_RESET_CODE, AUTH_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS).

response.name: 200 OK
400 Invalid or expired code
429 Too many incorrect attempts

request.description: Creates a company and its first (owner) user atomically, then auto-logs in — same token pair shape as Log in. The test script saves accessToken, refreshToken, and companyId (decoded from the access token) into the environment.

response.name: 201 Created
409 Email or tax number already in use

request.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh pair. Rotates the token: the old refresh token is revoked and cannot be reused.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Invalid, expired, or revoked

request.description: Revokes the given refresh token immediately, ending that session.
Returns the profile of the user identified by the current access token.
